title: Brazil PCV10 (age group 9): standard SC vs proximal negative-control estimators
paper: Qiu, Shi & Tchetgen Tchetgen (2024), 'Doubly robust proximal synthetic control', Brazil 2010 PCV10 application
note: The two proximal cells this case cross-checks -- the outcome bridge h and the single-instrument DR[A] -- come off the same R script and the same run as the sibling bundle benchmarks/reference/dr_proximal_brazil/. They are captured here so the standard-vs-proximal contrast is reproducible where R is unavailable, which includes CI. The standard-SC cell is reported from mlsynth: R's Synth is not part of this comparison.
